name: Default Repo Template + .md Governance
description: What should a default Claude Code repo look like? What CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md structure, what rules, what defaults ship out of the box?

name: Claude Code Skills
description: Which skills to include in a default setup. How to author them. Community-shared skill registries.

name: Session Management / Context Compaction
description: Claude's default context compaction loses state badly. Current best practice (Matt Pocock): backup context at ~100k tokens, /clear, reload backup. Need to verify if this fully solves context collapse or if additional structure is required.

name: Low-Level Frontend Verification
description: Claude will claim a UI change is live when it isn't. Need reliable verification via Playwright, Chromium, or similar that a change is actually rendered correctly.

name: Robust Testing / TDD Workflow
description: When are tests first created? How does a default template manage test-driven development across iterative FE work vs. large feature merges? How does Claude stay in sync with the test suite?

name: Design Systems
description: Default Claude doesn't guide toward a design system. Need: how is a design system standardized/defined? What is the default web app design system? How do we customize it?

name: Design Toolbar / Fast UI Iteration
description: Need to: (1) view design system tokens/primitives/components, (2) add to it, (3) navigate pages, (4) see viewports, (5) fast-iterate on UI similar to element inspector + claude.ai/design comment-on-element. Could be split: design system viewer + design toolbar.

name: Unified UX Layer Across Projects
description: A unified interface: see async tasks running across all projects, switch between projects, unified chat (Figma Make / claude.ai/design style), drill into specific agent sessions, cross-device (Mac, PC, mobile), cloud-persisted auth and integrations (GitHub, Neon, Render, etc.).
